why: I18 build: the prereg grammar checker built its sub-term table as a dict literal whose values are all evaluated before .get(tag), so the "call" entry a[1] (and the "field" / "alloc" entries) raised IndexError on every term with fewer than two arguments (['const', v], ['param', p], ['len', X], ['nil'], ...): grammar_problems crashed on any extracted document, so TestExtraction.test_terms_atoms_cells_and_sections_follow_the_grammar and TestToyDocuments.test_two_documents_valid_and_deterministic could not pass for any extractor. Fixed by wrapping each table value in a lambda and calling only the selected one: the sub-terms checked for every tag are exactly those the prereg table names (no rule, shape or ordering check changed). Reported under Surprises and Questions for the human.
